component.name: ChatonLM
component.summary: Unofficial desktop chat client for Ollama

description.p: ChatonLM is an independent, open-source desktop app for chatting with large language models that Ollama runs on this computer or on another one. It includes its own copy of Ollama, using the processor or the graphics card (Vulkan), for computers without it. Its design follows the official Ollama app for Windows and macOS.

ul.li: Chats with history, favorites, attachments, thinking and web search
Model management: download, load and browse models
Local dictation and text proofreading, with global shortcuts
Study tab: courses generated by a model on any subject
Interface in English, Spanish and French

description.p: ChatonLM is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Ollama. "Ollama" is a trademark of its owner and is used only to describe compatibility.

ul.li: Image generation in the chat: press the Image button, or ask a model that can use tools for a picture. Runs on your computer with a built-in image engine (stable-diffusion.cpp), on the graphics card or, more slowly, on the processor.
ModelHub, Images tab: pick free image models from Hugging Face (FLUX.2 klein, Z-Image and more), with what each one is good at, its speed, the graphics memory it needs and its license.
Easy Link: pictures made by the model are sent to your Telegram or Discord bot.
Context: a gauge shows how full the model's context is; long conversations can be compacted, automatically or on demand.
A model that loops is stopped or flagged.
Settings: a system prompt sent with every chat, and a graphics memory gauge.
ModelHub: an optional Uncensored section, hidden by default.
Easy Link: talk to your models from your own Telegram or Discord bot while ChatonLM runs on your computer (text, photos, voice messages, web search).
First launch: choose your language, then take a short guided tour of the app.
Models: a newer version of an installed model is announced and can be downloaded; downloads can be paused and resumed.
Study: courses can be paused and resumed, and lessons read aloud.
Proofread: the corrected text is pasted in place of the selection.
